title.fr: Dynamique de translation (lois de Newton, théorème du centre d'inertie)

formula: Σ F_ext = m · a_G   (2ème loi de Newton, théorème du centre d'inertie)
sketch:
Observe: SVG scene with a block on horizontal surface; student
toggles applied force F, mass m, friction f. ΣF arrow drawn as
vector sum; block accelerates per a = ΣF/m (2ème loi de Newton).
Position and velocity graphs drawn. Experiment: 3 seeded target
acceleration values; student picks F, m combos to match. Evaluate:
force arrows and acceleration HUD hidden; student picks F from
observed motion alone. Wrinkle: référentiel galiléen assumption
surfaced explicitly.
